description: Test utility functions for media player filtering, including support for audio/video test files, component creation, and input buffer handling.

methods.name: GetContentTypeFromAudioCodec
methods.description: Returns MIME type string based on audio codec and attributes.

methods.description: Returns list of supported audio test files based on options and constraints.

methods.name: GetSupportedVideoTests
methods.description: Returns list of supported video test parameters.

methods.description: Creates audio decoder and renderer sink components.
